mentions.description: A tool the author built and likes, but whose full capabilities are too complex for users to understand, which makes marketing difficult since people won't try it out.
mentions.problem: The tool's capabilities are too complex for people to grasp, so users don't try it, the author gets no feedback to improve it, and simplifying it would undermine what makes it special.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built this tool, it's great, I love it, but its full capabilities are too complex to udnerstand.
mentions.author: egrm
